historical_record.description: A house stood at this number from 1884, and may have been an older building — one appears here on the 1857 U. S. Coast Survey map — remodeled that year. It came down after 1914 and made way for a garage addition to the flats around the corner on Larkin Street.

unknowns: Footnote 11 on p. 16 prints this address as "1208 Larkin" while placing it in the block north of Lombard; Appendix I pp. 11-12 gives 1208 Lombard Street throughout. The report does not reconcile the two.
